user_holds_ghybr_shares.meaning: user holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR via GovernanceHYBR.deposit, with funds locked in the shared veNFT

withdraw_completed.meaning: GovernanceHYBR.withdraw completes without a revert from VotingEscrow.multiSplit

locked_hybr_withdrawable.meaning: legitimate user can withdraw their locked HYBR position (no self-DoS on exit)

claims.scope: GovernanceHYBR.withdraw full exit forwarding split legs to VotingEscrow.multiSplit

preconditions.text: User holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR via GovernanceHYBR.deposit, with funds locked in the shared veNFT.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A gHYBR holder exiting their entire position must be able to complete GovernanceHYBR.withdraw without a revert from VotingEscrow.multiSplit.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Legitimate users cannot withdraw their locked HYBR when their remainder or fee share is zero, causing a self-DoS on exits.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The user's exit is a full exit of all shares, as described in the report scenario.
The zero split leg (remainingAmount or feeAmount) is the trigger for the multiSplit revert; the report does not fix which leg is zero.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the locked_hybr_unwithdrawable impact; the multiSplit revert and withdrawal failure are treated as the mechanism, not separately formalized.
Whether shares are burned or state changes before the revert is not stated and is not encoded.
